# Aver — Deep Documentation Index

> Start with `llms.txt`. This file is not a second compact guide; it is a routing index for deeper docs, examples, and implementation context.

## Recommended read order

1. `llms.txt` for syntax guardrails and the minimal working shape of an Aver file
2. `docs/language.md` for the full surface-language contract
3. `docs/services.md` for stdlib and effect namespaces
4. one or two raw `.av` examples close to your task
5. `AGENTS.md` only if you need repository internals or implementation details

## Primary docs (read these first)
- [llms.txt](https://averlang.dev/llms.txt) — compact language overview with examples
- [Language Guide](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/language.md) — complete surface language reference
- [Services (stdlib)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/services.md) — all namespaces and their APIs
- [Common Pushback](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/pushback.md) — questions, objections, honest answers

## Advanced topics
- [Independence (?!)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/independence.md) — parallel products
- [Constructors](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/constructors.md) — constructor routing rules
- [Oracle](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/oracle.md) — proof export for classified effectful functions via `verify fn trace` + `given` stubs
- [Lean proof export](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/lean.md) — verify blocks to Lean 4
- [Dafny verification](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/dafny.md) — verify laws to Dafny/Z3
- [WASM backend](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/docs/wasm.md) — browser compilation

## Examples (raw .av files)
- [Calculator](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/core/calculator.av) — Result types, verify blocks, decisions
- [Temperature](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/core/temperature.av) — pure functions, recursion, classification
- [Order Total](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/core/order_total.av) — records, verify laws, domain modeling
- [Console Demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/services/console_demo.av) — effectful code, Console namespace
- [Oracle Trace](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/formal/oracle_trace.av) — `verify fn trace` with `given` stubs for classified effects (Random, Disk, Console.readLine, Tcp, Time.sleep, Terminal.*)
- [Oracle Independent Products](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/formal/oracle_independent_products.av) — per-branch trace assertions for `!`/`?!` products
- [Two Rolls Paradox](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/formal/two_rolls_paradox.av) — `verify` passes, `aver proof` rejects: sample-vs-universal divergence on the same law
- [Snake](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/games/snake.av) — single-file game with Terminal effects
- [Game of Life](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/examples/games/life.av) — cellular automata, FPS counter

## Project
- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/README.md) — project overview and quickstart
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jasisz/aver/main/AGENTS.md) — AI context file with architecture and implementation notes
